generation.prompt:
Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 × 1536.

Subject: place one extremely simplified, cute, endearing beaver head on the background, reduced to one soft rounded continuous silhouette and one defining feature: the pair of front incisors. Reuse these character colors rather than adding a separate facial color. Keep the head, facial marks and background clearly separated.

Never center or bottom-center the character. Show only the head, without a body.

Prefer one clear shape over several explanatory details. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Finish: show only the character on the full-canvas background, with clean surfaces and normal square outer corners.
Constraints: Use no text or watermark. Add no borders, frames, cards, or presentation masks. Include one character only, with no extra subjects or scenery. Use no fragile lines, sharp tips, unnecessary outlines, tiny details, or decorative marks. Add no photorealistic material, dramatic bevel, glossy hotspot, deep occlusion, extrusion, strong three-dimensional rendering, or external cast shadow. refinements.providerModel: Not exposed by the tool interface; built-in tool explicitly approved.
refinements.prompt:
Edit the supplied image of the chestnut-and-cream beaver head. Keep the same beaver identity, warm chestnut and cream color families, sage-teal full-canvas background, lower-left emergence composition, viewing orientation, large character scale, and gentle friendly expression.
Make a restrained refinement that feels rounder and more adorable: soften the overall head into a plumper round shape; make both cheeks fuller with smooth broad curves; make both ears a little more compact and circular; make the nose slightly smaller with softer rounded corners; shorten the two front incisors and round their ends while keeping them clearly visible and unmistakably beaver-like. Keep the eyes simple and softly rounded, and preserve the tiny gentle smile. Maintain a large forehead and compact baby-like proportions.
Keep both ears visible and keep the character emerging from the lower-left, with the same square composition and approximately the same occupied area. Do not move the character to the center.
Use large clean graphic shapes, a single continuous rounded silhouette, and only two character base colors: warm chestnut brown and warm cream. Keep the muted sage-teal background simple and uniform, filling all open areas. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Change only the requested character proportions and curvature. Do not add fur tufts, whiskers, eyebrows, blush, props, clothing, extra colors or facial decorations. Do not add text, watermark, frame, border, scenery, external cast shadow, glossy highlights, strong three-dimensional rendering, photorealistic materials, or another character. Deliver one full-resolution 1:1 square image.
